knowledge_point.title: Identifying a Matrix by Its Description

question.:question/problem:
Which of the following is a $2\times 3$ matrix?

Select all that apply.

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}4 & -3 & -0.1 \\ 1.1 & -2 & 4 \\ 3 & 7 & 2\end{aligned}],\,C=[\begin{aligned}5 & -1 \\ -2 & -1 \\ -0.1 & 1\end{aligned}],\,D=[\begin{aligned}7 & -0.1 & -2 \\ 5 & \sqrt{3} & -0.1\end{aligned}]
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
- The matrix $B$ has $3$ rows and $3$ columns. So, its dimensions are $3\times 3.$ $\,\times $

- The matrix $C$ has $3$ rows and $2$ columns. So, its dimensions are $3\times 2.$ $\,\times $

- The matrix $D$ has $2$ rows and $3$ columns. So, its dimensions are $2\times 3.$ $\,✓$

Therefore, only $D$ is a $2\times 3$ matrix.
